name: cp2_repeat_purchase_research_v1
unit: One first recorded programme per confidently matched customer; linked upsells are one programme
target: A different recorded paid programme purchased strictly after the first date and within 90 days
features: Only initial-day sale amount/missingness, package, pest, premise and month seasonality. No later upsell values, appointment totals, final balances or future repeat flags.
purge: Every training label's 90-day window must end before the next evaluation cohort begins
selection: Highest development average precision; fixed 20% review capacity; freeze before test scoring
acceptance: Minimum 20 positives in test, AP greater than prevalence, top-20%-capacity lift >1.5 and 90% customer bootstrap lift lower bound >1. No production promotion without forward validation.
prior_inspection: Feasibility audit inspected only cohort size and prevalence: development 262/8 positive and 2026 test 557/19 positive. No model scores inspected before this declaration. This small positive count means the acceptance minimum cannot pass in this source snapshot.
limitations: First recorded purchase is not necessarily first-ever purchase. Current identity matching and corrected records are retrospective. Repeat labels reflect recorded purchases, not intent or satisfaction. Expanding multiple tasks is exploratory; no guarantee of good performance.
